_comment: De-PII'd /v1/user/info for hermetic /console. uid+uuid present => logged-in session (PermissionWrapper renders, not bounced to /login). teams:[] => currentTeam=null => NOT basic role => ConsumeMonthlyChart takes the real /v1/user/queryConsumeMonthly path (not the blurred mock-data path). isQuestionnaire:true keeps the CustomerInfo 'ACCOUNT SETUP' survey Dialog CLOSED (it opens only when isQuestionnaire===false), so the page is interactable. All identifying fields are synthetic placeholders.
